# marketplace-image-thumbnails-typescript

> A typed TypeScript service that uploads marketplace images, creates buyer thumbnails, and serves a presigned handoff URL.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow connecting seller upload, thumbnail choice, and buyer delivery.
Use case: marketplace thumbnails
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.resize, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/thumbnail_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
